notes: Mailwoman mark: an envelope built from the three primary shapes on a near-black field.
Blue: the envelope body, a rectangle with a V cut from its top edge. Yellow: the flap, a triangle sitting in the V.
Red: a circular seal on the point of the V. No shape touches another: every edge is shape against field.
Units are the variant's grid. A shape's gap paints it grown by that many units in the field colour first.
Each output size uses the variant with the smallest maxSize it fits. At 16 px the seal is left out.
scripts/icons/build-icons.py reads this file; see README.md in this directory.
